body:
Issue #893: gate-manifest record <gate> --ticket <id> succeeds against a malformed store or an unknown ticket id.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Add packages/gate-manifest/lib/ticket-check.mjs exporting nearMissIds and validateRecordTicket and wire it into packages/gate-manifest/bin/gate-manifest.mjs on record.
2. When a ticket store is present in <dir> and fails to load, exit 1 quoting the loader error without modifying the manifest.
3. When a ticket store is present in <dir>, --ticket <id> is supplied, and <id> is not in the store, exit 2 listing near-miss ids and pointing to --allow-unknown-ticket; with --allow-unknown-ticket, record as normal (exit 0).
4. When no ticket store is present in <dir>, record --ticket <id> behaves as today (exit 0).
5. Add unit and CLI tests in packages/gate-manifest/test/gate-manifest.test.mjs.
Verify: node --test packages/gate-manifest/test/gate-manifest.test.mjs packages/gate-manifest/test/ticket-completion-reminder.test.mjs
title: gate-manifest: validate --ticket against the ticket store on record with --allow-unknown-ticket escape (#893)
